resources.string: They work without internet and without any AI.
Everything happens on the phone: your voice and your texts never leave it. It only connects to download the models you choose.
With internet, the system’s dictation and your agent’s AI; without internet or without an AI, the phone’s own.
Always on the phone, even with internet. The most private.
Every language, with punctuation. Best on fast phones.
Small and quick: it writes as you speak, without punctuation.
Apps that use the system’s dictation use it too.
Each language comes with English, both ways. Between two other languages, it goes through English.
No connection. Try again on Wi‑Fi.
Not enough space on the phone.
Open models: Whisper (OpenAI, MIT), Vosk (Alpha Cephei, Apache 2.0) and OPUS‑MT (University of Helsinki, Apache 2.0 / CC BY 4.0).
It’s removed from the phone. You can download it again whenever you like.
“Hey…” uses it to hear its name, so it will download it again.
